description: The next Making Tax Digital for Income Tax deadlines from today: the next quarterly update (with the period it covers) and the next Self Assessment tax return and payment date, plus the upcoming list, the penalty rules that apply now and a calendar feed. Give start_year to see only the dates for people who start MTD that year.

count.description: How many upcoming deadlines to list, 1 to 12. Default 6.

start_year.description: The April the person starts MTD (2026: income over £50,000 in 2024-25; 2027: income over £30,000 in 2025-26; 2028: income over £20,000 in 2026-27). Leave out for every deadline.

name: get_mtd_deadlines
title: Get MTD deadlines
